names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 31 ianuarie, «Sfântul Mucenic Claudiu».

Read out of saint.gr's own heading for him on the page for the seven martyrs of 31 Ιανουαρίου, «Αγιος Κλαυδιος», with the rank word left off; the day's line keeps the seven together as «Άγιοι Ουικτωρίνος, Ουίκτωρ, Νικηφόρος, Κλαύδιος, Διόδωρος, Σαραπίνος και Παπίας».

death.note: doxologia.ro's life: «au fost prinşi, pentru mărturisirea lui Hristos, în vremea împăratului Deciu, în anul 250».

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).

feast.note: doxologia.ro keeps him again on 5 aprilie, where the day page prints «Sfântul Mucenic Claudie» (https://doxologia.ro/5-aprilie, read 25 September 2026) and heads the day's hymns «Troparul Sfinţilor Mucenici Claudie, Diodor, Victor, Victorin, Papia, Nichifor şi Serapion» — the same seven martyrs of Corinth this row is for. The corpus keeps one feast to a church, so he renders on 31 ianuarie only.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 31 ianuarie — «Sfântul Mucenic Claudiu»
Ορθόδοξος Συναξαριστής (saint.gr), 31 Ιανουαρίου — «Άγιοι Ουικτωρίνος, Ουίκτωρ, Νικηφόρος, Κλαύδιος, Διόδωρος, Σαραπίνος και Παπίας»

attestations.note: Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).
